target.description: Predict each selected visual electrode’s broadband response time course to single and repeated image presentations from stimulus timing and image category. The original performance comparator is the category-scaled DN model used in Figure 3C.

split.description: Original stochastic rule:12 folds over72 conditions,66 training/six test traces per fold with one test condition per image category and12 temporal conditions per category. Published assignments are absent from the inspected unseeded random.sample implementation. Recover them if available, or reproduce this exact source-authorized stochastic recipe with a logged seed and immutable fold manifest. Candidate and author must share rerun folds; source-protocol parity and a predeclared justified tolerance to published results are required. A changed split unit, altered condition allocation or new participant holdout is an extension.

inputs.description: Binary stimulus-presence time course and image-category identity; target traces comprise six image categories crossed with six single-stimulus durations and six repeated-stimulus ISIs. Fitted parameters, published target traces and assessment labels are not candidate prediction inputs.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source common-average rereferencing, broadband extraction, artifact/trial/responsiveness selection, run-wise prestimulus correction and averages for all 72 conditions. Original full fits use named response samples 0..818; source CV positional columns2:821 include temp_cond and omit the last response. Resolve publication lineage before choosing source_positional_cv versus corrected named_response_columns. Figure3 responsive/none/S and active category-selective/P callers are not interchangeable.

metric.description: For each held-out trace, R² = 1 − sum_t(y_t−prediction_t)² / sum_t(y_t−mean(y))², using the pinned NaN handling; higher is better. Code rounds condition values to three decimals and fold means to four.

aggregation.description: For each held condition compute original trace R² with source NaN behavior, round to three decimals; average six conditions and round fold to four; average all twelve folds and round electrode to four. Retain every electrode and separately summarize V1–V3, VOTC and LOTC using source 1,000 electrode-resample medians, median of medians and16th/84th percentiles. These descriptive electrode bootstraps are not independent-participant superiority inference.
